messages.text:
Hello!
I just saw on helium pool the discount code
“HarloSpin”
Is it possible to get the $1 discount added to my order?

Thank you
Jon P.

Hi Jon,

Thanks for writing in, and good spot on the code.

Codes like HarloSpin are for new orders, so we're not able to apply one to an order that's already been placed. What I can tell you is that it stays valid for your next purchase: just enter HarloSpin in the discount box at checkout and it comes off there.

Sorry I can't add it retroactively. If there's anything else on your order you'd like me to check, just reply here and I'll take a look.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Order Shop····

Would that still apply if I only placed the order yesterday?
I appreciate your time.
Jon P.

Hi Jon,

I'm afraid it does, yes. Promotional codes apply to new orders only, whatever the date, so even one placed yesterday is outside it. It isn't something I can apply after the fact or refund the difference on, and I'm sorry to give you the same answer twice.

The good news is the code is still yours to use. Pop HarloSpin into the discount box at checkout on your next order and it comes straight off.

Shop···· is noted here, so if you'd like me to confirm where it stands or when it ships, just say the word and I'll check it for you.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
